title: Welcome to the Machine Learning Section!

cues.en: Congratulations on reaching the second half of the Course machine learning each machine learning algorithm in this section of the Course will consist of five parts.
cues.zh: 恭喜進入課程後半段：機器學習。這部分每個演算法都有五個部分。

cues.en: We'll start off with a light theory lecture then you'll have an optional supplemental reading assignment in part three will go ahead and show the practical implementation Python of the machine learning algorithm
cues.zh: 先從簡單理論教學開始，再有選修補充閱讀。第三部分實際用 Python 實作機器學習演算法。

cues.en: Part 4 will be your portfolio project exercise and imperf. five will go ahead and walk through the solutions to that exercise.
cues.zh: 第四部分是作品集專案練習，第五部分逐步講解解答。

cues.en: These are my favorite topics to teach and I'm so excited to get started.
cues.zh: 這些是我最喜歡教的主題，非常期待開始。

cues.en: Thanks and I'll see you at the next lecture.
